thread:
Liam O'Connor: Heads up for July close  discovered an A/B promo routing bug. A subset of customers in cohort B got invoice-level credits instead of post-bill rebates. Estimated unbilled usage = $98,300 gross; credits applied automatically to invoices for cohort B = $27,100. Need accrual vs deferral guidance and approver routing. Backup: https://tiny.redwood/close/2210
Priya Desai: Detail: service delivered in July, so accrual appropriate. The routing bug changed how credits are recorded (line-item vs rebate). Does accounting prefer netting now or wait until invoices run?
Jared Kim: Engineering/Revenue Ops says credits are deterministic for cohort B (tied to experiment AB-COHORT-B-07) and will appear on invoices. They're not discretionary. My inclination: reflect expected billing and net the accrual. Draft JE (net):
```
DR 1300 Unbilled AR 71,200
CR 4000 Revenue - Usage 71,200
Memo: Net accrual for July unbilled usage after expected AB-COHORT-B-07 credits
```
Liam O'Connor: Gross JE would be the full 98,300 then a contra entry for promo accrual if we treated credits separately. Which is cleaner for auditors?
Priya Desai: Policy: if credits are predictable and tied to delivery, netting is acceptable and preferable to avoid temporary contra-revenue. But net > $50k so CFO sign-off required. Please attach per-customer breakout and experiment export.
billing-bot: Uploads: ab_export_AB-COHORT-B-07.csv (received 2210001200).
Jared Kim: Added per-customer calc and the export in the spreadsheet (tab: CFO_pack). Link: https://tiny.redwood/close/2210#gid=5
CFO_Jess: Reviewed quickly. I approve net accrual methodology. Need consolidated backup (per-customer lines, experiment export, and the JE math) in one sheet by EOD. Also add a one-line disclosure to the close notes explaining the routing bug and rationale for netting. Once posted, tag close-pack PR #616 for final sign-off.
Liam O'Connor: Will consolidate and post NetSuite JE tomorrow AM for net $71,200, add disclosure to close pack, and tag PR #616. Any objections?
Jared Kim: :thumbsup: go for it.
Priya Desai: Thanks all. I'll update the revenue schedule with the net accrual and note the billing-rule ticket BILL-4102 for the routing bug.
__notes: Slack thread about month-end accrual impacted by an A/B promo routing bug; includes JE code block, bot upload, CFO approval, and links.
